jobDescription:
Lead front-end web development for public-facing, highly regulated, and multi-regional platforms serving millions of international users. Work across C#/Razor (ASP.NET MVC), modern JavaScript, and SCSS to build high-performance, accessible, and localized web experiences.

  • Performance & Optimization: Led front-end performance overhauls across high-traffic core pages (lazy loading, caching strategies, asset preloading, and CI-based performance audits), significantly improving Core Web Vitals and load times.
  • Reusable Component Architecture: Engineered modular, reusable UI widgets and interactive components shared across multiple international portals and product sites.
  • Analytics & Tracking: Managed and streamlined event tracking and telemetry migrations (GA4, GTM), ensuring reliable data pipelines for marketing and business intelligence.
  • Build Tooling & Developer Experience: Modernized build pipelines by transitioning front-end builds from legacy task runners to Vite, drastically reducing build times and improving local dev workflow.
  • Design Systems & Localization: Implemented design system standards across key customer journeys, delivering fully responsive, dark-mode, and RTL/multilingual localized interfaces compliant with WCAG accessibility standards.
  • SEO & Technical Standards: Implemented technical SEO best practices, structured data (JSON-LD), and core landing page optimizations.
  • Team & Best Practices: Authored technical documentation, developer guidelines, and shared best practices for AI-assisted development across engineering workflows.

I've been in charge of WordPress websites (installations, maintenance, optimization, customization to both frontend & backend), Lead the development of an interactive accessibility tool for people with disabilities. Helped with building of web applications & worked with various API's, took part in creating ERP interfaces. Optimized websites with the recommendations of google PAGE INSIGHTS (such as: caching, minification, content delivery).

Learned AngularJS, gained more PHP & MYSQL experience. Started working with GIT & AWS services (EC2, S3).

Created a unique accessibility tool for the company which covered 65% of WCAG AA requirements. I was in charge of website innovation, required research on my part in UX / UI. Helped implementing methods for Google Analytics Events, later on with Google's Tag Manager. Implemented several jQuery galleries & plugins, also wrote some of my own. Customized the "Bsmart" application backend system for the client needs.

Learned working with Bootstrap, perfected JavaScript & jQuery Skills. Mainly worked with XSLT, HTML5, ASP, CSS, JavaScript & jQuery.
Installed, maintained and customized Drupal, Joomla and WordPress sites. Built static HTML/CSS websites and landing pages. Worked with cPanel, Control Web Panel, Plesk and DirectAdmin.
